text: むしポケモンは　しんかが　はやくて　たのしいよな！

structure.jp: しんかが　はやくて

patterns.name: 〜て (linking)
patterns.explanation: An い-word changed to くて joins on to the next part, like 'and so'. はやくて たのしい = 'quick and so fun'.

patterns.name: 〜よな
patterns.explanation: よな at the end states your view and asks the listener to agree. たのしいよな = 'it's fun, isn't it!'.
